name: hrr-title-ab
purpose: iter-458 H-VQ (Astra 035/036): within-roll hostRangeReadable cache A/B on a QUIET title. Reaches the title exactly as physfree_gameplay.json does (same first four steps), then sends NO input while SR_HRR_CACHE_WINDOW (process age, seconds) switches the cache OFF -> ON -> OFF. Valid only while the title stays up across all three windows: any loading, ScrGenPop dialog or attract movie inside a window rejects that comparison. Run with -TimeoutSeconds 600 and gates SR_HRR_CACHE=1,SR_HRR_CACHE_WINDOW=90-120 (the window uses a dash: sr_drive splits -Gates on commas, which invalidated hrr1).

steps.name: quiet-title
steps.purpose: No input. The cache window (process age 90-120 s) sits inside this dwell; the final OFF window runs to its end.
